title: Just Leaf It: Accelerating Diffusion Classifiers with Hierarchical Class Pruning
summary: A hierarchical approach to diffusion classification that prunes irrelevant label groups, reducing class evaluations and speeding up inference.
note: Presented at ICANN in Padua, Italy. Arundhati S. Shanbhag and Brian B. Moser contributed equally.

title: HyperCore: Coreset Selection Under Noise via Hypersphere Models
summary: Adaptive coreset selection using class-specific hyperspheres to identify useful training samples in noisy datasets.

title: PRISM: Diversifying Dataset Distillation by Decoupling Architectural Priors
summary: Dataset distillation with different teacher architectures for supervision and regularization, encouraging greater diversity in synthetic training data.

title: SubZeroCore: A Submodular Approach with Zero Training for Coreset Selection
summary: A training-free approach to choosing representative data subsets by balancing coverage and local density.

title: Diffusion Models, Image Super-Resolution, and Everything: A Survey
summary: A survey of diffusion-based image super-resolution, covering foundations, methods, open challenges, and future research directions.

title: Audio-Visual Environmental Cues in Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Exploring audio-visual environmental information for human–robot interaction.
